title: Tenses review
description: Present perfect simple y continuous, going to y past simple.

sections.title: Present perfect simple
sections.use: Para hablar de **experiencias** en tu vida sin decir cuándo ocurrieron. En preguntas se usa mucho *ever* (alguna vez) y en respuestas *never* (nunca).

examples.en: No, I have never eaten tripe.
She has been to London twice.
examples.es: Ha estado en Londres dos veces.

mistakes.why: Si dices **cuándo** (*yesterday, last week, in 2020*), usa el past simple.

sections.title: Present perfect continuous
sections.use: Para acciones que **empezaron en el pasado y siguen ahora**. Equivale a «llevar… haciendo». Se pregunta con *How long…?* y se responde con *for* (periodo) o *since* (desde un momento).

forms.label: Afirmativa
forms.example: I have been working here for 9 years.

forms.label: Pregunta
forms.pattern: How long + have / has + sujeto + been + verbo-ing?
forms.example: How long have you been working at the EOI?

examples.en: How long have you been working at the EOI?
examples.es: ¿Cuánto tiempo llevas trabajando en la EOI?

examples.en: I have been working at the EOI for 9 years.
examples.es: Llevo 9 años trabajando en la EOI.

examples.en: She's been learning English since September.

mistakes.wrong: I am working here for 9 years.
mistakes.right: I have been working here for 9 years.
mistakes.why: Para «llevar X tiempo haciendo algo» no se usa el presente.

mistakes.wrong: I've been living here since 3 years.
mistakes.right: I've been living here for 3 years.
mistakes.why: *for* + periodo (3 years); *since* + punto de inicio (2021, Monday).

sections.title: Going to
sections.use: Para **planes e intenciones** que ya has decidido, y para predicciones cuando ves que algo va a pasar.

forms.label: Afirmativa
forms.pattern: sujeto + am / is / are + going to + infinitivo

forms.label: Negativa
forms.pattern: sujeto + 'm not / isn't / aren't + going to + infinitivo
forms.example: I'm not going to eat dessert.

forms.label: Pregunta
forms.pattern: Am / Is / Are + sujeto + going to + infinitivo?
forms.example: Are you going to eat dessert?

examples.en: Are you going to eat dessert?
No, I'm not going to eat dessert.
examples.es: No, no voy a tomar postre.

examples.en: Look at those clouds! It's going to rain.

mistakes.why: No olvides el verbo *be* (*am / is / are*).

sections.title: Past simple
sections.use: Para acciones **terminadas en un momento concreto** del pasado: *yesterday*, *last week*, *in 2019*, *five years ago*.

forms.label: Afirmativa
forms.pattern: sujeto + verbo en pasado (-ed o irregular)

forms.label: Negativa
forms.example: I didn't meet him at work.

examples.en: Where were you yesterday? — I was at home.
When did you meet him? — I met him 5 years ago.
examples.es: ¿Cuándo lo conociste? — Lo conocí hace 5 años.

mistakes.why: Después de *did* el verbo va en infinitivo.
*ago* va detrás del periodo de tiempo.
